Surf Cup Sports events

2027 Surf Nation Champions League

Event Dates: From Feb 13, 2027 to Feb 15, 2027
Entry Deadline: Jan 11, 2027
Details:

The Surf Nation Champions League brings together all U14 teams across the entirety of Surf Nation to showcase their talent at Surf Sports Park in San Diego, CA

 

The 2027 Surf Nation Champions League will feature teams from the u14 age group.

Over four guaranteed matches, players will compete in front of Surf Select scouts and coaches, with the opportunity to be identified for a coveted spot on the Surf Select National Team. Additionally, every game will be filmed and broken down utilizing Taka’s industry-leading match and player analysis tools.

Surf Nation is proud to continue the Surf Select Platinum Program during the 2027 Surf Nation Champions League. Top players in the u14 age group will be scouted and identified during the event for a spot on the Surf Select National team and a fully-funded trip to Surf Cup International Salou, one of Europe’s most prestigious youth football tournaments. Learn more about the Surf Select Platinum Program here.

Tournament Details:

Dates: February 13-15th, 2027

Location: Surf Sports Park, Del Mar CA

Tournament Fee: $1095.00

Please Note – each team will play 4 games including a Monday game. If traveling out of state please do not book a flight prior to 6:00pm Monday February 15th. 

This IS a stay and play event. Teams cannot book hotel rooms until they receive notification of acceptance from the event and any teams based over 100 miles from Surf Sports Park in Del Mar, CA are required to book all reservations through Athlete Travel’s booking system. Booking with Airbnb or any independent booking service or other hotel booking company is not permitted. Teams will be disqualified for not following this policy. There is no opt out option for this policy so please understand that before submitting your application.

2027 Surf Challenge

Event Dates: From Jan 16, 2027 to Jan 18, 2027
Entry Deadline: Dec 12, 2026
Details:

Kick off the new year at Surf Challenge 2027! Get back on the pitch after the holiday season and put your skills to the test against top competition from all leagues. Boys and girls teams U8–U14 are invited to compete over MLK weekend, January 16–18, 2027, at Surf Sports Park in Del Mar, California.

Details:

  • Dates: January 16–18, 2027
  • Location: Surf Sports Park | 14989 Via De La Valle, Del Mar, CA 92014
  • Age Groups: Boys & Girls U8–U14
  • Game Guarantee: 3 games per team
  • Format: Group play begins Saturday, with semifinals and finals beginning monday.

Eligibility

Surf Challenge is a Class I tournament open to USYS, US Club Soccer, USSSA, and FIFA-affiliated teams. The event is sanctioned by US Club Soccer, and all players must have valid 2026/2027 player cards to participate.

Team Housing

Surf Challenge includes a dedicated housing program to help traveling teams stay together throughout the tournament. Additional details provided on the registration form.

Surf College Cup Olders

Event Dates: From Nov 27, 2026 to Nov 29, 2026
Entry Deadline: Oct 30, 2026
Details:

 

Welcome to Surf College Cup!

This year the boys and girls older event will be held at the Surf Sports Park and the Socal Soccer Complex.

The event will take place November 27-29, 2026.

The girls will play in Oceanside

The boys will play Del Mar 

Every team will play one 80-minute game, per day, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. These will be pool-play games and ensures that all teams get 3-games guaranteed while providing the players quality play time in front of hundreds of college coaches.

This is a Class I event open to USYS, US Club Soccer, USSSA and FIFA affiliated teams. This event is sanctioned by US Club Soccer and ALL players can have 2025/2026 or 2026/2027 player cards to participate.

Registration deadline: 

Girls  October 7th 2026 at midnight.

Boys October 7th 2026 at midnight.
 

U15-U19 $1995

Follow tournament coverage on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok @SurfSportsEvents and on YouTube @InsideSurfSoccer.

 

Tournament Dates: 

November 27-29, 2026

STAY & PLAY POLICY

This is a Stay & Play tournament. All traveling teams are required to book accommodations through our travel partner, Athlete Travel. There is no opt-out for this policy so we kindly ask that you understand before submitting your application.

Upon acceptance into the tournament, team managers can expect to receive communication from Athlete Travel within 10 days. 

Please note that all teams traveling to the event must use Athlete Travel. There is no opt-out of this policy. By submitting an application, teams acknowledge and agree to comply with this requirement.

A minimum of 8 hotel rooms per team is required. Teams that do not meet this minimum will be assessed a buyout fee, which will be invoiced prior to the event. Your failure to enforce this policy with your team will result in disqualification with or without notice. 

Using Hotel points, Rewards, and Discounts such as AAA, are not allowed. Online reservations through travel websites such as Travelocity and Expedia are not allowed. Reservations can only be made through the Athlete Travel booking portal. 

If you have any questions regarding this policy, please email [email protected]

Girlazo

Event Dates: From Jul 11, 2026 to Jul 12, 2026
Entry Deadline: Jun 27, 2026
Details:

 

Introducing GIRLAZO — the inaugural girls-only youth soccer experience at Surf Sports Park.

Inspired by those incredible moments, the golazo that won the game, and celebrated a team coming together! This event celebrates the love of the game, and the fun that all young girls have while playing a sport they love. It's a community coming together to raise girls up, find joy building their skills and confidence on and off the field. You don't want to miss it!

Girlazo is a girls-only youth soccer tournament (U8-U19) at Surf Sports Park in Del Mar, California.

The event will be held July 11-12th. 2026 and features 3 guaranteed matches for participating teams along with festival activity space filled with games, music, food trucks, merch, and more.

Event Dates: From May 21, 2026 to May 25, 2026
Entry Deadline: Apr 18, 2026
Details:

Club América Cup 2026 is returning to San Diego with top teams from North, Central, and South América giving youth soccer players an experience unlike any other. 

Push your teams to the next level with new styles of play, peak competition, and a cross-cultural community experience that develops players on and off the pitch.
